result.summary: S1 FAIL, decisive: independently verified with a real Postgres instance that chapter assignment (both the silent single-active-chapter branch AND the chapter-selection callback) writes users.chapter_id BEFORE consent_pd_at is set -- confirmed with a real fresh-user /start (chapter_id non-null, consent_pd_at still null) and this is the MAJORITY deployment path, not an edge case. The consent wording also never discloses chapter-membership storage. S2 PASS (callbacks scoped to ctx.from.id, forged-callback negative case constructed and confirmed safe). S11 PASS (no PII in any log call). All other invariants N/A by inspection. Migration confirmed additive, no S13 trigger.

issues.description: S1 violation: chapter assignment (apps/bot/src/handlers/start.ts lines 96-101 silent branch, and lines 156-176 the chapter callback) persists users.chapter_id before consent_pd_at is non-null, in the majority-path flow (single active chapter, or a returning user picking a chapter). Must defer chapter assignment until after consent is recorded, or disclose chapter-membership storage in the consent wording and gate the write behind acceptance.
